scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:web
scripts.db:script: dotnet tool restore && dotnet tool run dotnet-ef migrations script --idempotent --project src/backend/Analytics.Api/Analytics.Api.csproj --startup-project src/backend/Analytics.Api/Analytics.Api.csproj
scripts.db:update: dotnet tool restore && dotnet tool run dotnet-ef database update --project src/backend/Analytics.Api/Analytics.Api.csproj --startup-project src/backend/Analytics.Api/Analytics.Api.csproj
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:web
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
